test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

k r _ t g _ p _ r t t _ m _ k _ t _ g _ p

options.text: t m k g r r t m
t k m g p r t m
t m g k p r t m
t m k g p r t m

solution:
**Given:** k r _ t g _ p _ r t t _ m _ k _ t _ g _ p

Lets check the options one by one:

 
• t m k g r r t m → k r **t** t g **m** p - **k** r t t **g** m **r** - k **r** t **t** g **m** p
 
• t k m g p r t m → k r **t** t g **k** p - **m** r t t **g** m **p** - k **r** t **t** g **m** p
 
• t m g k p r t m → k r **t** t g **m** p - **g** r t t **k** m **p** - k **r** t **t** g **m** p
 
• t m k g p r t m → k r **t** t g **m** p - **k** r t t **g** m **p** - k **r** t **t** g **m** p

 
• Here k r t t g m p is repeated.

Hence, **‘****t m k g p r t m’** is the correct answer
